newsitem.title: USA: James River, Fort Howard to merge in $5.8 bln deal.
newsitem.headline: James River, Fort Howard to merge in $5.8 bln deal.

text.p: James River Corp. and Fort Howard Corp. said on Monday they signed a definitive merger agreement to create a $7 billion paper and tissue products company to be called the Fort James Corp.
Fort Howard shareholders were to receive 1.375 shares of James River stock for each Fort Howard share, the equivalent of $42.45 a share, in a deal valued at $5.8 billion, including assumed debt.
